meta.title: Buyer revokes a pending counter offer
gaps: The exact setup named in the case—a specific RFQ in evaluation with Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90—cannot be selected by title or reproduced from the prepared state, which provides one live vendor bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The exact setup named in the case—a specific RFQ in evaluation with Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90—cannot be selected by title or reproduced from the prepared state, which provides one live vendor bid.

steps.note: Open the prebuilt RFQ event without creating or searching for another event.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the vendor bid and counter-offer controls are shown.
Open the comparison grid required before sending a buyer counter offer.
Send the counter offer against the prepared vendor bid.
Verify the buyer view marks the counter offer as pending.
Return to the Responses grid to access the pending offer's revoke control.
Revoke the pending counter offer for the vendor bid.
Verify the buyer again has the Counter Offer action after revocation.
Return to Master QCS to verify the original bid value was restored.
Verify the vendor's original bid value is active again; the prepared bid value is held by the API.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the event overview to inspect whether a pending counter offer remains visible to the vendor.
Verify the vendor no longer sees a pending counter offer.
Open the vendor's pricing sheet after revocation.
Submit a revised bid to verify the vendor can revise again after the counter offer is revoked.
Verify the vendor's revised quote was accepted and submitted.
